title: Launching our first OpenAI Certifications courses
summary: Learn how OpenAI’s new certifications and AI Foundations courses help people build real-world AI skills, boost career opportunities, and prepare for the future of work.
body: Learn how OpenAI’s new certifications and AI Foundations courses help people build real-world AI skills, boost career opportunities, and prepare for the future of work.
summaryZh: OpenAI正式推出首批官方认证课程及AI基础课程，旨在帮助开发者和从业者掌握大模型应用开发的核心技能。这些课程涵盖了从基础概念到实际应用开发的知识体系，旨在通过标准化认证提升人才的职业竞争力，并加速AI技术在各行各业的落地应用。此举标志着OpenAI在构建AI人才生态系统方面迈出了重要一步，通过官方背书确保了技能培训的专业性与行业相关性。
